changes.title: AWS IoT Core now supports custom domain names for the AWS IoT credential provider
changes.detail: AWS IoT Core now enables you to use configurable endpoints , including custom domain names, when your devices request temporary credentials from the AWS IoT credential provider to securely call other AWS services. Your devices can now use domains you own for both messaging and credentials, and hence AWS endpoint names need not be hard coded into device firmware. This makes it easier to manage, migrate, and scale your device fleet.
